mission: Confirm every parallel-boolean flattening of a single domain state variable with cited E1-E4 evidence, then refactor confirmed instances to LiteralKit/tagged-union/option-literal shapes that delete their coherence guards.

provenance.note: Graduated from the 2026-08-17 boolean-creep grill session and its ratified operator prompt (WebStorm scratch COMMON_CODE_SMELL.md). Not graduated from an explorations/ packet.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until every implementation and the final reflection/completed-retained closeout are merged to main after Yeet proves each exact PR head merge-ready.

phases.name: Bootstrap packet
phases.exit: Packet on disk; inventory seeded (10 confirmed + 4 disqualified) and schema-valid; DECISIONS.md seeded.

phases.name: Inventory sweep (grok lanes) to GATE 1
phases.exit: Original corpus swept until dry; lane outputs merged; 100% of qualified evidence verified; Benjamin ratified the confirmed inventory.

phases.name: Moving-main inventory and design refresh (Codex; current routing in AGENTS.md)
phases.exit: The current corpus is dry for two consecutive rounds; every qualified record has verified evidence and a corrected design.

phases.name: Independent review and delegated GATE 2 transition
phases.exit: A replacement exact-source receipt covers 100% of qualified records and designs with zero findings; the packet-only ratification PR is merged.

phases.name: Apply and land serial Tier 1 batches and Tier 2 singletons
phases.exit: Every implementation PR is merged to main and each implemented inventory record is applied on canonical main.

phases.name: Exact-main dryness and close
phases.exit: Two consecutive exact-main rounds add no qualified records; reflection and completed-retained lifecycle are merged and verified on main.

stopConditions: A sweep lane cannot honor the evidence gate after one prompt correction.
A design requires persisted/wire encoded-shape changes without a viable byte-compatible proof.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
